title: 한국농공학회논문집 2026년 제68권 3호
headline: 이번 호의 핵심 흐름은 ‘관개 · 가뭄 · 취약성’(3편)입니다. 가장 많이 등장한 키워드는 ‘agricultural reservoir · 농업용 저수지’이며, 서울대학교 연구진이 3편으로 가장 활발했습니다.
bullets: 새로 등장한 키워드: ‘compaction’, ‘time-dependent effect’, ‘Collaborative governance’, ‘integrated water management · 통합물관리’, ‘inter-basin water transfer’.
주로 쓰인 방법론: 시스템다이내믹스, CFD, 유한요소법, 인공신경망.

papers.title: 시스템 다이나믹스를 이용한 태양광 확대가 농촌 지속가능성에 미치는 다차원적 영향 분석
papers.title_en: Assessing the Multidimensional Effects of Solar Power Expansion on Rural Sustainability - A System Dynamics Approach -

summary.result: The simulation results indicate that while large-scale solar expansion significantly reduces net carb on emissions and increases regional income (GRDP), it accelerates population decline by diminishing rural landscape attractiveness.
summary.background: A regional model was developed for Jeollanam-do, South Korea, integrating population dynamics, economic activity, land use, and carb on emissions.
summary.method: Notably, agrophotovoltaic (agroPV) systems were found to provide the most balanced outcome, mitigating population loss while achieving moderate economic benefits and substantial carbon reduction.

papers.title: 수위 변동 패턴 분석을 통한 농업용 저수지 퇴사량 간접 추정 기법 개발
papers.title_en: Indirect Estimation of Sediment Deposition in Agricultural Reservoir Using Water Level Fluctuation Pattern Analysis

summary.result: Results indicate that approximately 48,930 m 3 of sediment has accumulated in the 50-60% storage rate range, accounting for about 4.2% of the original design capacity.
summary.background: The approach was applied to Waryong Reservoir in Sacheon, Gyeongsangnam-do, using long-term hydrological observation data collected from 1997 to 2024.
summary.method: The proposed approach offers the advantage of estimating sediment volume without requiring detailed stage-storage survey data or precise bathymetric measurements.

papers.title: YOLOv12-seg을 이용한 팜맵 기반의 농경지 내 시설 분할 모델 개발
papers.title_en: Development of a FarmMap-based Facility Segmentation Model Using YOLOv12-seg

summary.result: Notably, by combining deep learning inference results with worker verification in a collaborative workflow, mAP@50-95 improved significantly from 0.812 to 0.961, demonstrating that both accuracy and efficiency in FarmMap update operations can be simultaneously achieved.
summary.background: FarmMap is a digital agricultural land map based on high-resolution aerial imagery, containing boundary and attribute information (paddy fields, upland fields, orchards, facilities, etc.) of cultivated farmland, and is utilized in various administrative and research fields such as direct payment inspections and disaster insurance assessments.
summary.method: A dataset of 30,000 image-label pairs was constructed by combining FarmMap and aerial orthoimages, and an effective pre-processing method was proposed using clipping and cropping techniques.

papers.title: 논토양 물리성에 따른 폭염기 콩 필요수량 평가
papers.title_en: Soybean Irrigation Requirement during Heatwaves as Affected by Paddy-Soil Physical Properties

summary.result: At ETc = 5 mm day -1 , IR = 0 mm when Z e = 56 cm, indicating soil water storage alone met crop demand.
summary.background: We aimed to (i) estimate soybean effective rooting depth (Z e ) across representative topographic settings and soil textures of Korean paddy fields using physical constraints of the compacted layer, and (ii) quantify irrigation requirements (IR) during heatwaves.
summary.method: Using 2025 weather records from Suwon, Jeonju, and Jinju, mean daily crop evapotranspiration (ETc) during 10 consecutive dry days averaged 4.8-8.1 mm day -1 .

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs)를 활용한 스마트팜 온실 내부 공기 흐름 예측 모델 개발
papers.title_en: Development of an Airflow Prediction Model Inside a Smart Farm Greenhouse Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks

summary.result: When compared with the conventional finite element-based CFD results, it was confirmed that the PINNs could reproduce physically consistent flow characteristics without mesh generation.
summary.background: To overcome these challenges, a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINNs) was applied to predict airflow inside a naturally ventilated greenhouse (7.0 m in width, 4.0 m in height, and 24.0 m in length) located at Kyungpook National University Farm.
summary.method: The front-view model considered the roof slope and utilized a deep neural network with four hidden layers (128-128-128-64 nodes), while the top-view model was simplified into a rectangular geometry (7.0 m × 24.0 m) with three hidden layers (64 nodes each).

papers.title: 파이프 줄기초 극한인발저항력의 초기 다짐 조건에 따른 시간 경과 효과 특성
papers.title_en: Time-Dependent Effects of Initial Compaction Conditions on the Ultimate Uplift Capacity of Continuous Pipe Foundations

summary.result: A s a result, the ultimate uplift capacity showed a clear increasing trend up to 21 days compared with the day of construction.
summary.background: Due to the increasing frequency of extreme weather events, the importance of protected horticulture is being emphasized.
summary.method: Continuous pipe foundations were constructed with two initial compaction conditions (2-layer and 4-layer compaction), and ultimate uplift capacity was evaluated on the day of construction, and 8, 21, and 76 days after construction.

papers.title: 농업용저수지 수계간 물 이동 갈등 해결을 위한 협력적 거버넌스의 역할
papers.title_en: Role of the Collaborative Governance to Resolve Transboundary Water Transfer Conflicts in Agricultural Reservoir Watersheds

summary.result: As a result, attention has shifted from traditional, infrastructure-centered approaches to collaborative governance-based water management.
summary.background: In recent years, South Korea has institutionalized integrated water management through the enactment of the Framework Act on Water Management, the establishment of River Basin Water Management Committees, and the formulation of comprehensive basin management plans.
summary.method: The research focuses on the drivers of cooperation, the roles of key actors and institutions, the process of negotiation and consensus-building, and issues such as new intake facility construction and cost-sharing arrangements.
